name: Template Skeleton Creator
author: Apurv Bhatt

sections.description:
Template Skeleton Creator is a lightweight WordPress plugin that allows developers to quickly generate WordPress template files directly from the admin dashboard.
Instead of manually creating template files, the plugin provides a simple interface where users can select predefined template options and generate the required template structure automatically.
This tool helps streamline the development workflow by reducing repetitive tasks and saving development time.
Template Skeleton Creator is especially useful for developers who frequently build custom WordPress themes or need to create multiple template files during development.

Features

  • Generate WordPress template skeleton files
  • Easy-to-use admin interface
  • Predefined template options
  • Saves development time
  • Lightweight and developer friendly
  • No coding required for basic usage

Usage

  1. Access the Plugin:

    • Go to the WordPress admin panel.
    • Navigate to Settings -> Template Skeleton Creator.

  2. Create a Template:

    • Select from the predefined template options.
    • Fill in the required fields with the necessary values.
    • Click Generate to create the custom template file.

  3. Manage Templates:

    • View and manage your created templates from the plugin’s interface.
    • Edit or delete templates as needed.

License

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/template-skeleton-creator directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the Template Skeleton Creator settings to configure and create your custom templates.
sections.faq:
Can I create multiple templates using this plugin?

Yes, you can create and manage multiple templates.

Are there any prerequisites for using this plugin?

No specific prerequisites are needed other than having a WordPress site.

Is this plugin compatible with all WordPress themes?

This plugin should be compatible with most WordPress themes. However, custom or heavily modified themes may require additional adjustments.
